BiblicalUsage: The children of Keros are listed among the Nethinim who returned, in Ezra's list and again in Nehemiah's. A temple servant's family, named among the returning exiles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Nethinim are named because serving the house of God is worth recording, and Keros is on the list twice.
